workarounds.note: the print H1 restates breakBefore because a headings object drops it

relink() rewrites every palette-linked colour from the night palette before the screen build: 1.4.1 leaves design-slot colours and bodyText.referenceColor at their inline hex (gotcha palette-skips-designs)

both samples are copy-fitted so no note spills a two-line, widow-protected tail onto a new page: 1.4.1 gives that page's column one line of height and the canvas clips the second line (EF-72 repro: append "At night it throws a car’s headlights back at the driver, which is why fog lamps sit low and shine flat." to the fourth paragraph of the English Fog note; the issue grows to 5 pages and page 4's 29 px column holds a 58 px, two-line block)
resourceTypes: defaultResourceTypes(LANG), because config.locale does not name the figures (gotcha resource-types-locale)

the samples cite figures as 'as Fig. 2 shows' / 'la fig. 2 muestra', never '(Fig. 2)': the resizable screen edition is ragged and would sooner or later break a line between '(' and the reference (gotcha ragged-run-punctuation)

headings.balancing.stretchAfterFloats: false keeps the text level under a column float on a note's closing page: without it 1.4.1 drops that column one 14 pt line, on the English Rain page (under the gauge) and the Spanish Wind page (under the rose) (gotcha float-stretch-closing-page)

the shadow root wraps renderToHtml's output in a div with all: initial: 1.4.1's .pt-doc inherits the host's letter-spacing, word-spacing and text-transform, which overprint lines measured without them

the screen pane keeps a min-height of 400 px (style.css and the script's fallback): in 1.4.1 an advanced-design opener taller than the page's content area loses its whole reservation, minHeight included, and the body prints over it with no warning; at 240 × 340 and 270 × 320 px the Rain opener (in English, the title and a seven-line lead) overlaps the first paragraph in both languages

the screen overrides set bodyText.avoidWidows: false: with it on, 1.4.1 places a paragraph taller than the page's content area whole in an empty column with room for one line (under a float), when the widow rule refuses a one-line split, so it runs off the foot of the page (seen at panes of 240–280 × 410–520 px)
